anomalies.impact: The two MOSFETs appear swapped between the valve position and the reverse-polarity position. The ATO valve is now switched by a 30 V device on a 24 V inductive load whose turn-off transients are only clamped to ~24 V by D4 and the 28 V TVS (D2), leaving little/insufficient Vds headroom; the valve driver can avalanche or fail, so ATO filling may stop working. (The reverse-polarity slot getting the higher-rated AON6407 is harmless.)
